INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES — MOCK EXAM #12
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES, the best classroom habit is: (1 mark)
   A. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day
   B. Only memorise without using the language
   C. Mix random languages with no purpose
   D. Avoid speaking to classmates

2. When practising Reading 1.2.1 Reading comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Reading 1.2.1 Reading comprehension.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 1.2.1 Reading comprehension.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Reading 1.2.1 Reading comprehension.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 1.2.1 Reading comprehension.

3. When practising Listening and Speaking 4.1.1 Conversational Skills, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 4.1.1 Conversational Skills.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 4.1.1 Conversational Skills.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 4.1.1 Conversational Skills.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 4.1.1 Conversational Skills.

4. When practising Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for comprehension.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for comprehension.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for comprehension.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for comprehension.

5. When practising Writing 2.3.1 Essay writing, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Writing 2.3.1 Essay writing.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Writing 2.3.1 Essay writing.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Writing 2.3.1 Essay writing.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 2.3.1 Essay writing.

6. When practising Reading 2.2.1 Extensive Reading: Library Skills, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 2.2.1 Extensive Reading: Library Skills.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Reading 2.2.1 Extensive Reading: Library Skills.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Reading 2.2.1 Extensive Reading: Library Skills.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 2.2.1 Extensive Reading: Library Skills.

7. When practising Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Attentive listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Attentive listening.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Attentive listening.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Attentive listening.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Attentive listening.

8. When practising Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Listening for information, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Listening for information.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Listening for information.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Listening for information.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Listening for information.

9. When practising Writing 1.3.1 Social writing - SMS, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Writing 1.3.1 Social writing - SMS.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Writing 1.3.1 Social writing - SMS.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 1.3.1 Social writing - SMS.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Writing 1.3.1 Social writing - SMS.

10. When practising Writing 3.3.1 Writing for Information, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Writing 3.3.1 Writing for Information.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Writing 3.3.1 Writing for Information.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Writing 3.3.1 Writing for Information.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 3.3.1 Writing for Information.

11. When practising Reading 3.2.1 Extensive reading: Vocabulary building, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 3.2.1 Extensive reading: Vocabulary building.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Reading 3.2.1 Extensive reading: Vocabulary building.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Reading 3.2.1 Extensive reading: Vocabulary building.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 3.2.1 Extensive reading: Vocabulary building.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
12. In three clear sentences, explain Reading 4.2.1 Reading for information - Visuals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Writing 4.3.1 Creative Writing – Dialogue and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Listening and Speaking 5.1.1 Conversational Skills – Tongue Twisters and Riddles and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Reading 5.2.1 Reading for Information and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Writing 5.3.1 Creative writing – Narrative composition and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Listening and Speaking 6.1.1 Listening for information and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Reading 6.2.1 Reading Comprehension: Reading Strategies and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Writing 6.3.1 Essay writing – expository composition and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
